mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the effective federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) as of the most recent month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months with FEDFUNDS below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.3 percentage points from the prior month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, prompting expectations of Federal Reserve monetary easing and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months where UNRATE rises by more than 0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 0.5% and a stable federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 4.5%) signals stagflation risk, causing equity market sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months meeting the trigger condition (CPIAUCSL rise >0.5% and FEDFUNDS<=4.5%).

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion phases (INDPRO > 115), the S&P 500 exhibits negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates monetary tightening and economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months with INDPRO > 115.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) as of the most recent month indicates robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months with HOUST above 1200.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly level of nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeding 138,000 thousand signals a robust labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months with PAYEMS > 138000.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1200 and retail sales (RSAFS) above 380,000 signals strong consumer demand and economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months meeting the trigger condition (HOUST>1200 and RSAFS>380000).

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of real GDP (GDPC1) above 11,600 billion dollars indicates sustained economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of quarters with GDPC1 > 11600.
